raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 7, Reason for Mistake: Misread the source and conflated “Rupert, King of Germany” (Rupert III of the Palatinate) with Rupert II, Elector Palatine; despite the Wikipedia page clearly stating John was the son of Rupert III, the Planner incorrectly concluded Rupert II, leading to the wrong father-in-law.
